reason: Original C0 USDT expiry surface absent from live official inventory; official notice says final maturity 2026-06-26. No price/funding outcomes read before amendment.
primary_expiry_surface: OKX BTC-USD and ETH-USD inverse coin-margined expiry futures
selection: earliest live expiry 30 to 120 days beyond exchange timestamp; no selection on basis size
inverse_face_notional: N = integer contract lots times USD contract face value
base_spot_quantity: q = N / entry_futures_price; gross spot purchase q/(1-spot_fee) rounded upward to spot lot
terminal_usd_value: q*S + N*(1/S - 1/F0)*S = N when spot equals settlement index and q=N/F0; rounding dust tracked separately
collateral: 80 percent of acquired base coin posted as isolated futures collateral; rest held as same-venue unencumbered spot. Other USD/USDT cash receives zero interest, no emergency transfer assumed.
fees: spot 0.1 percent each side; futures entry 0.05 percent of N/F0 coin; settlement 0.01 percent of N/S coin; actual close 0.05 percent N/F coin
execution: depth buy spot asks and short inverse bids; 2bps adverse extra each fill; proportional coin fees reduce terminal guarantee and are included, not ignored
settlement_mismatch: spot disposal versus 30min index averaging or different official-page description unresolved; +/-10bps and +/-1percent residual tracked as scenario, exact simultaneous settlement hedge unproven
historical_scope: since listing or latest90d, whichever shorter, same-contract basis marks and representative ledger; no expired-contract rolls silently spliced
other_rules: C0 costs, clock quality, cash opportunity, stress and authorization boundaries retained
